locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quarta via: et hoc dicimus Deum
interpretation: Sibling of AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA-DICIMUS-DEUM-A, which keeps et hoc dicimus Deum as a report of usage. Here it is read as the nominal definition the five ways use as their middle term (q.2 a.2 ad 2): hoc, a single thing, the something that is cause of being to all beings and, by the preceding steps, maximal in being, is what the name 'God' is given to. The identification is nominal: it says to what the name is applied, not that this being has the attributes the Summa later proves of God. That the name in q.2 a.3 and in q.105 a.5 is one name with one use is part of this reading. The clauses et bonitatis, et cuiuslibet perfectionis are not formalized.
